title: Dimension of Disaster: Demon Slayer
start: Talk to Aris in her tent south-west of New Varrock square.
prereq_quests: Dimension of Disaster: Coin of the Realm

items.t: Beer glass or beer (obtainable during quest)
Black robe outfit (purchased from Thessalia's Fine Clothes (New Varrock) by 90 zemomarks) or New Varrock Cultist outfit

rewards.l: Crafting XP lamp (Dimension of Disaster: Demon Slayer)
Magic XP lamp (Dimension of Disaster: Demon Slayer)

rewards.t: Access to ingredients for strength potions in the New Varrock demon camp
Only three strength potions may be made as the six ingredients, limpwurt root and red spiders' eggs, are obtained only once from looting the chest in the south-east corner of New Varrock

steps.t: Talk to Aris in New Varrock Square. [Chat: Accept]
Talk to Sir Prysin in a house north-west of the church.
Search everything inside the house and the drain outside until you find the key.

sub.t: Replay: The key will always be found in the same place you first found it.

steps.t: Climb down the trapdoor inside the church along the western wall (be sure to complete the dialogue).

sub.t: Replay: Click the trapdoor, complete the dialogue, then head straight to Aris.

steps.t: Attempt to pull Silverlight. You will fail.
Talk to Aris in her tent, she will give you a spirit measure.
Head to the cemetery north of the New Varrock west bank and inspect the tombstone stack next to the statue of Zemouregal on the north wall.
Talk to Spirit of Faith. Move 1 step east. Talk again. Then watch the short cutscene.
Pick up a rotten tomato in the crate north of the Blue Moon Inn and pick a cabbage to the south of the pub.
Talk to Dr Harlow in the Blue Moon Inn (exit dialogue after the first box comes up). Your Spirit measure may say "WooOOooOOooOOooOOooOOoo!" when you do.
At the cost of 2 Zemomarks, buy beer from the Bartender in the Blue Moon Inn. [Chat: 1 A glass of your finest ale. › 4 Nothing, thanks.]

To get dog hair, go west to Gertrude's house, just north of the tanner. Search the kennel next to her house. [Chat: 1 Yes. › 1 Yes. › 1 Reach left. › 1 Yes. › 2 Reach right. › 1 Rub in some jelly. › 3 Reach further in. › 1 Leave it where it is.]
Talk to the Apothecary to the south-east of the Kennel. [Chat: 2 Do you know a potion to sober someone up? › 4 Nothing, thanks.] He will use the cabbage, dog hair, and rotten tomato.
Add sobriety potion to beer for a sobriety potion in a beer glass.
Talk to Dr Harlow.
Talk to the Spirit of the Body, and let them kill you [Chat: 2 Would you killing me count? › 1 Yes, do it - I'll be fine! › 1 Yes! Kill me already!]
Fill vial with blood at blood fountain at the front of the Varrock castle or north-west of eastern bank.

sub.t: Optional: Take a free bronze sword from the weapon store two buildings south of Aris (only necessary if you don't have any other weapons yet).

steps.t: Head to the house south of Sir Prysin's house (near the church).
Search the southern bookcase.
Kill the animated book.
Talk to Spirit of the Mind. [Chat: Any › Any › Any › Any › Any › Any › Any › Any › Any › Any › Any]

sub.t: Replay: [Chat: 4 I'm looking for you! › 3 A sword that slays demons. › 4 I need it to help Delrith get home. › 4 Agrith Naar. › 4 Aris!] (Always choose the last option whenever that last option says, "I'm looking for you!")

steps.t: Climb down the trapdoor in the church.
Take Silverlight from the altar.
Buy a black robe set from Thessalia's Fine Clothes (90 Zemomarks)

sub.t: Replay: Can use cosmetic override (Cultist outfit) if bought, or saved outfit.

steps.t: Pick a black mushroom by Evil Dave in south-east New Varrock.
Use the mushroom on your Silverlight for a dyed version.
Equip the robes and dyed Silverlight, then talk to Evil Dave (located South-East of New Varrock)

sub.t: The Darklight and the dyed Silverlight override do not work with Silverlight equipped.

steps.t: Pass barrier.

sub.t: Optional: It is recommended to loot the chest in the northeast corner of the area to work towards completing the Pick All achievement.

steps.t: Talk to Delrith.
Talk to Delrith again for the fight (First time only: Don't forget to loot the chest).
Fight with Agrith Naar - choose "Yes".

sub.t: Replay: Choose "Yes" to skip the fight if unlocked from Aris' Reward Shop.
Run away when Agrith says "Prepare to be incinerated!"

steps.t: Pass barrier.
Return to Aris.
Quest complete!

p: The player is touching the kennel.
The tombstone stack next to the statue.
Drawing a circle of blood for Delrith.
